{'index': 0, 'translation': "Apple today expanded the availability of watchOS 27.0.1 to more Apple Watch models, following last week's initial rollout on Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4. Details below."}

{'index': 1, 'translation': 'Apple Watch users can now install watchOS 27.0.1'}

{'index': 2, 'translation': 'Last week, Apple exclusively rolled out watchOS 27.0.1 for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, fixing an issue that could cause some devices to unexpectedly restart.'}

{'index': 3, 'translation': 'Today, Apple is pushing watchOS 27.0.1 to all other Apple Watch models compatible with watchOS 27, including:'}

  • {'index': 9, 'translation': 'Apple Watch Ultra 3'}

{'index': 10, 'translation': 'Apple has not changed the release notes for watchOS 27.0.1, which still read as follows:'}

{'index': 11, 'translation': 'Likewise, this release carries the same build number 24R365 as the version rolled out last week for the Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.'}

{'index': 12, 'translation': 'Alongside watchOS 27.0.1, Apple also released iOS 27.0.1, iPadOS 27.0.1, visionOS 27.0.1, iOS 26.7.1, macOS 27.0.1 Golden Gate, macOS Tahoe 26.7.1, and macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 today.'}

{'index': 13, 'translation': 'Among these, iOS 27.0.1 fixes an issue that could cause some iPhone 18 Pro models to restart when using Face ID, while the remaining updates include additional bug fixes and security improvements.'}
